messages:
Sara L.: Quick heads up — new model onboarding failing our quantized runtime tokenization parity check. float vs int8 shows +2.8% perplexity on the golden set.
Leo H.: logs? sample inputs?
Sara L.: here's a problematic sample: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog" tokenized float: [22, 345, 9, 788, 45, 1023] quantized: [22, 345, 9, 255, 45, 1023] — looks like unknown token inserted.
Maria P.: could be vocab remapping during export. Did the tokenizer merge table change? Also check BOS/EOS handling.
Anish K.: run token-diff helper: ```python tools/token_diff.py --model path/to/model --exported tok.json --inputs golden.jsonl``` it prints token-level diffs and detokenized mismatch.
Sara L.: ran it, attached output (small snip): ```tok mismatch: idx 3: 'Ġjumps' vs '<unk>' ; avg KL = 0.0032 over golden dist```
ingest-bot: smoke: onboard-8745 quant-int8 failed token-parity (threshold 0.01) — see run 2024-11-03_14:02
Leo H.: suggests adding explicit tokenizer checksum step into intake pipeline (pre-bench). compute sha of tokenizer config + merges and require exact match or fallback flag.
Maria P.: tradeoff: exact match will block slightly-updated tokenizers (minor patch) — maybe allow char-level equivalence + KL < 0.02 as soft pass.
Anish K.: propose new mini-step: 1) token parity check (exact for top-1k tokens), 2) sample decoding KL/perplexity delta threshold, 3) auto-mark for manual review if near boundary.
Sara L.: sounds good. I'll draft a small RFC patch for pipeline: add 'tokenizer-parity' binary, CLI and threshold config, and a recorded artifact for audits.
Leo H.: can we also log mapping of <unk> occurrences to S3 for triage? :+1:
Maria P.: yep. Also update onboarding docs noting exporters must preserve tokenizer files and merges.
Sara L.: assigning action items: Sara -> RFC + unit tests; Anish -> implement token_diff helper into intake; Leo -> S3 artifact hooks; Maria -> doc updates. Thanks all.
Leo H.: cheers :tada:
